clue.text: Irritable person runs into vehicle

indicators.note: runs goes into the vehicle, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: a cab is a vehicle, a taxi
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A bad-tempered person charges into a car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into' puts R inside CAB.
explanation.definitionFit: A crab is informal for a grumpy, crotchety person, from crabby.

clue.text: Descendant covering up for raised whip

indicators.note: the descendant is wrapped around the other piece, hiding it from view

parts.note: a scion is an heir or descendant

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means the word for is written upwards, so backwards

parts.note: pro means in favour of, for

explanation.surface: An heir conceals a whip held aloft.
explanation.walkthrough: A scorpion as a whip comes from the Bible: Rehoboam threatens to chastise with scorpions rather than whips.
explanation.definitionFit: A scorpion was a biblical scourge, a whip set with spikes, as in Rehoboam's threat.

clue.text: They're often in schools to seek information, say

definitions.meaning: creatures that swim in groups called schools
to angle or probe for facts

explanation.definitionFit: Fish swim in shoals called schools, and to fish is to try to draw out information.

clue.text: Dramatist not so friendly after opening of show

indicators.note: the colder word follows the single letter
the opening of a word is its first letter

parts.note: chiller means cooler in manner, less friendly

explanation.surface: A playwright turns frosty after the first night of the show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'opening of' gives S from show; 'after' puts CHILLER behind it.
explanation.definitionFit: Friedrich Schiller was a German playwright, author of Mary Stuart and William Tell.

clue.text: Supposedly influential body putting energy into factory

indicators.note: energy is put into the factory, one piece inside the other

parts.note: a plant is an industrial works or factory
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A body thought to hold sway is fuelling a works.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into' puts E inside PLANT. 'Supposedly' fits because astrologers claim planets shape our lives.
explanation.definitionFit: Astrology holds that heavenly bodies such as Mars or Venus influence human affairs.

clue.text: One who predicts things in advance, up in complicated star lore

indicators.note: the turned-up word sits in the middle of the rearranged letters
complicated suggests the words star lore are tangled into a new order
in a down clue, up means the word for advance is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: to go is to advance, move forward

explanation.surface: A seer peers into the future through intricate lore of the stars.
explanation.walkthrough: 'complicated' rearranges STAR LORE to ASTROLER; 'up' turns GO into OG, which goes 'in' it. The first 'in advance' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A horoscope writer claims to forecast events from the positions of the stars.

clue.text: As opposed to one with ring, perhaps?

definitions.text: As opposed to one with ring, perhaps?

parts.words: As opposed to one with ring, perhaps?
parts.note: someone wearing a wedding ring is married; the contrast is a person never wed and so chaste, and also the zodiac sign Virgo

explanation.definitionFit: A maiden who has never married or had sex contrasts with a wife who wears a ring.

clue.text: Perform song, with piano introduction

indicators.note: the piano letter comes first, as an introduction to the song

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly
a lay is a song or ballad

explanation.surface: Sing a number with a piano intro.
explanation.walkthrough: 'introduction' puts P before LAY.
explanation.definitionFit: To play a piece is to perform it, as musicians or actors do.

clue.text: Some muscles tire badly, absorbing cold

indicators.note: the rearranged letters soak up another piece, taking it inside
badly signals the word tire is jumbled

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on a tap

explanation.surface: Muscles grow weary in the chill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' rearranges TIRE to RETI, and 'absorbing' takes C inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Recti, plural of rectus, are straight muscles such as the abdominal rectus muscles.

clue.text: Like space that remains after various pieces removed from isosceles triangle

indicators.note: several letter groups are cut out of the phrase, leaving the rest in order

explanation.surface: A geometry lesson: the gap left after chopping bits off a triangle.
explanation.walkthrough: From ISOSCELESTRIANGLE, remove ISOS, R, NG and the final E to leave the answer in order.
explanation.definitionFit: Celestial describes the heavens or outer space, the realm of the stars.

clue.text: Bring this, having changed indication of delivery period

indicators.note: having changed signals the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Fetch this, now altered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having changed' shuffles BRING THIS.
explanation.definitionFit: Your zodiac sign is fixed by when you were born, so it signals the time of your birth.

clue.text: Origin of game's inscribed in stone here

definitions.text: Origin of game's inscribed in stone here

parts.words: Origin of game's inscribed in stone here
parts.note: a plaque at an English public school records that the oval-ball game began there when William Webb Ellis picked up the ball

explanation.walkthrough: RUGBY School, in Warwickshire, has a stone tablet commemorating the supposed birth of the sport in 1823.
explanation.definitionFit: The town and school gave their name to the sport said to have been invented there.

clue.text: Frivolous sex among Romans revealed in hearing

indicators.note: the Roman number shows up inside the court case, contained by it

parts.note: a trial is a court hearing
sex is Latin for six, written VI in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A racy Roman scandal comes out in court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sex among Romans' is not intercourse: sex is the Latin word for six.
explanation.definitionFit: Something trivial is of little importance, light and unserious.

clue.text: Pair usually sharing 11 — that could be this

definitions.text: Pair usually sharing 11 — that could be this

parts.words: Pair usually sharing 11 — that could be this
parts.note: two siblings born the same day share a zodiac sign, and Gemini is itself the sign of a matching pair

explanation.definitionFit: Siblings born together nearly always have the same star sign, and Gemini is represented by a duo.

clue.text: Repetitively teaches one way to ruin clues? I can't

indicators.note: jumbling letters is one way of ruining the words clues and I can't

explanation.surface: A solver protests: drumming in the rules wrecks clues, I can't cope.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one way to ruin' rearranges CLUES ICANT.
explanation.definitionFit: To inculcate is to instil an idea by persistent instruction and repetition.

clue.text: So far, won't fully — having switched ends

indicators.note: the first and last letters of the phrase trade places

parts.note: won't written out in full is will not

explanation.surface: Someone refuses to go any further, then swaps sides.
explanation.walkthrough: Expand won't to WILLNOT, then swap its first and last letters, W and T.
explanation.definitionFit: Up to now, hitherto: as of yet, to the present time.

clue.text: Capturing leaders of the enemy in conflict as basis for solution, often

indicators.note: the conflict takes the leading letters prisoner, holding them inside

parts.note: war is armed conflict

indicators.note: leaders are the first letters of each word

explanation.surface: Seizing enemy commanders in battle is often the basis of a resolution.
explanation.walkthrough: 'solution' tempts toward puzzles, but here it is a chemical solution, mostly made in this liquid.
explanation.definitionFit: Most chemical solutions are aqueous, with this liquid as the solvent.

clue.text: Charged, in a way, following a certain order

definitions.meaning: relating to particles carrying electric charge
built in one of the classical architectural orders, with scroll capitals

explanation.definitionFit: Ionic bonds involve charged atoms, and the Ionic order is a style of Greek column.

clue.text: Deliberately crash into vehicle, knocking piece off front

indicators.note: a piece is struck off the start of the vehicle, losing its first letter

parts.note: a tram is a street vehicle running on rails

explanation.surface: A driver smashes into a car on purpose and dents its bumper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocking piece off front' removes the T from TRAM.
explanation.definitionFit: To ram something is to strike it head-on with force, on purpose.

clue.text: Spotted initially mocking at a clue that's absurd

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of mocking
absurd signals the words at a clue are scrambled

explanation.surface: Seen at the start, someone sneers at a ridiculous clue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' gives M; 'absurd' rearranges ATACLUE to ACULATE.
explanation.definitionFit: Maculate is a rare word for marked with spots or blemishes, the opposite of immaculate.

clue.text: Good party organiser, one whose work is bound to be misattributed

definitions.text: one whose work is bound to be misattributed

parts.note: a host throws and runs a party

explanation.surface: A fine host is a writer whose books will carry someone else's name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bound' hints at books: a ghostwriter's volumes are credited to another.
explanation.definitionFit: A ghostwriter produces books published under someone else's name.

clue.text: What can be said about one drink that's not already said

indicators.note: the spoken word goes around the other pieces

parts.note: oral means spoken, able to be said
I is the Roman numeral one
gin is a spirit, a drink

explanation.surface: A remark about a single drink that nobody has made before.
explanation.definitionFit: Something fresh and new has not been expressed by anyone previously.

clue.text: Small pieces of furniture in homes of Arabs and others

parts.note: tables are pieces of furniture

explanation.surface: Little tables decorate houses in the Middle East.
explanation.walkthrough: Arabs here are horses, not people.
explanation.definitionFit: Horses such as Arabian thoroughbreds are housed in buildings with stalls.

clue.text: Head off participant in moving protest that's more shrewd

indicators.note: the first letter of the protester is cut off

parts.note: a marcher takes part in a protest march

explanation.surface: Stopping a demonstrator takes a sharper mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Head off' removes M from MARCHER. Arch means cunning or knowing.
explanation.definitionFit: Arch can mean sly or cunning, so the comparative means slyer.

clue.text: Does some climbing, making lots of notes

definitions.meaning: climbs up, as of a wall or mountain
series of musical notes rising or falling in pitch

explanation.definitionFit: To scale is to climb, and musicians practise runs of notes up and down an octave.

clue.text: Person spreading complaint about, namely in educational foundation?

parts.note: ca, circa, means about

indicators.note: namely goes inside the three letters of the foundation

parts.note: the three Rs, reading, writing and arithmetic, are the basics of schooling
i.e., id est, means that is, namely

explanation.surface: A disease spreader is found, it seems, in a school's founding.
explanation.walkthrough: The three Rs (reading, writing, arithmetic) are a British shorthand for basic schooling; complaint here means an illness.
explanation.definitionFit: A carrier transmits a disease to others, often without symptoms.

clue.text: Fitting material used in ugly cravat

indicators.note: the fabric's name is used within the run of letters of the two words

explanation.surface: Stretchy cloth goes into a hideous neckerchief.
explanation.definitionFit: Lycra is a stretchy fabric used for close-fitting clothes.

clue.text: Male with pride put up new work of art

indicators.note: in a down clue the pieces are put up, read upward, so backwards

parts.note: an oil is a painting in oils

explanation.surface: A proud man hangs up a fresh painting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put up' reverses NOIL. Pride is a group of these big cats.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of these big cats is called a pride, and the male heads it.

clue.text: Line I inserted in big band composition, improvising

indicators.note: the two letters are placed inside the rearranged band letters
a composition is something put together, so the words big band are rearranged

explanation.surface: A jazz soloist slots a line into a big band piece, making it up as they go.
explanation.walkthrough: The big band rearranged leaves a gap for the line and I after its second letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To ad-lib is to speak or play without preparation, extemporising.

clue.text: Kind of speculator that's on target

definitions.meaning: a trader who buys expecting prices to rise
the centre of a dartboard or target, a hit there

explanation.definitionFit: A stock market optimist is so named, and a shot to the bullseye is also called this.

clue.text: Vigorously attack lecherous type

definitions.meaning: a randy old man, a lecher

explanation.definitionFit: Go at means set upon, and an old goat is a lustful man.

clue.text: Excessively strain English king in public

indicators.note: the English king goes inside the public word

parts.note: overt means open, in public view
Rex is Latin for king, used in British legal titles

explanation.surface: An English monarch pushes himself too hard in full view.
explanation.definitionFit: To overexert yourself is to make too great an effort and strain the body.

clue.text: Climber in middle of Italian Alps

indicators.note: the plant's name sits within the middle of the run of letters

explanation.surface: A mountaineer halfway up the Alps in Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Climber' looks like a mountaineer but is a jungle plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A liana is a woody climbing vine of tropical forests.
